julie (pen-test): FYI found missing CloudTrail-style audit entries for kms:Decrypt around 2026-03-15T14:12:08Z in acct 12345. PoC shows app performed Decrypt but CloudTrail lookup returned nothing. Filed PT-432.

maria (eng-security): ack — can you paste the exact repro commands + timestamps?

julie (pen-test): repro I used: 
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt \\  --start-time '2026-03-15T14:00:00Z' --end-time '2026-03-15T14:30:00Z' --profile pen-test
```
returned zero hits. app logs show: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:08Z] svc=llm-infer user=svc-token request_id=abc123 action=decrypt key_id=arn:aws:kms:...
```

devon (support): correlating now — customer CS-789 reported 500s at the same time, stack shows a KMS Decrypt error/AccessDenied.

aisha (infra): is this AWS KMS (managed) or our HSM/KMS proxy in front of keys? need key metadata.

julie (pen-test): AWS KMS, alias x-redwood-prod, state ENABLED, rotation enabled. No obvious policy misuse in the PoC.

kyle (oncall): I queried prod CloudTrail in eu-west-1 and see KeyRotation events but no Decrypt for that request_id. There is an internal kms-proxy in the path; checking proxy access logs (/var/log/kms-proxy/access.log) shows: 
```
2026-03-15T14:12:08Z src=10.4.2.7 req_id=abc123 method=Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:... status=200
```
Which suggests proxy served the call but CloudTrail didn't record it.

maria (eng-security): hypothesis: proxy handled Decrypt locally (short-circuit or different role) and didn't forward audit events to the CloudTrail/S3 audit sink. Need reproducible steps to prove forwarding gap.

julie (pen-test): my repro steps: 1) assume pen-test-role 2) call KMS Decrypt via boto3 3) lookup CloudTrail => nothing. Snippet: 
```python
import boto3
k = boto3.client('kms')
resp = k.decrypt(CiphertextBlob=b'...')
print(resp)
```

devon (support): customer trace: nginx 502 -> backend svc logged "KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException" before retrying. Could be transient auth or the proxy path mismatch.

aisha (infra): quick mitigation idea: enable audit-forwarding from kms-proxy to our central audit sink (S3) for all operations in staging; don't push to prod until we confirm.

maria (eng-security): proposed severity P2 (high) — missing crypto audit entries + customer-facing 5xx. Julie, you recommended P1 originally?

julie (pen-test): I argued P1 because crypto audit gap is critical for compliance, but exploitability requires internal access. I'll accept P2 if we get a prioritized retest window.

kyle (oncall): action items: (1) infra enable proxy-forwarding in staging & repro (aisha) (2) support update customer with interim note (devon) (3) pen-test retest after staging patch (julie).

aisha (infra): enabling forwarding in staging now. config snippet: 
```yaml
AUDIT_FORWARD: true
AUDIT_SINK: s3://redwood-audit-staging/pentest/pt-432/
```
redeploying kms-proxy...

deploy-bot: started rolling deploy of kms-proxy to staging - build 2026.89.2

kyle (oncall): staging deploy finished. logs indicate proxy now emits audit records to staging S3. julie, can you retest?

julie (pen-test): retest running... same script now returns Decrypt event in audit S3: s3://redwood-audit-staging/pentest/pt-432/2026-03-15-14_12.json

maria (eng-security): paste the relevant JSON line (redact ciphertext) and confirm request_id match app log.

julie (pen-test): snippet (redacted): 
```json
{"eventTime":"2026-03-15T14:12:08Z","eventName":"Decrypt","requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:...","requestId":"abc123"}}
```
request_id abc123 matches the app log entry.

devon (support): updating CS-789: root cause likely proxy not forwarding certain KMS audit events for some routes; staged fix applied, prod deploy targeted in ~4h pending security signoff. No evidence of data exfiltration found so far.

maria (eng-security): post-mortem/next steps: (A) enable full audit forwarding in prod proxy (B) add a periodic reconciler that verifies app-level crypto ops appear in audit sink (C) add CI test to run Decrypt/Encrypt -> confirm events surface. Assign infra+security.

aisha (infra): opening infra tickets INFRA-2101 (proxy config + deploy) and INFRA-2102 (CI test + reconcilers).

julie (pen-test): after prod deploy, I'll retest and close PT-432 or escalate severity if missing.

kyle (oncall): thanks all. devon, please draft the customer update.

devon (support): draft message: "We've identified an issue where a proxy component intermittently failed to forward certain KMS audit events. A fix is staged and will be deployed to production within ~4 hours. We have no evidence of data exfiltration and will confirm once audit records are verified post-deploy."

maria (eng-security): +1 — I'll append a short compliance note about retention windows and evidence pointers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Attachments / evidence: s3://redwood-audit-staging/pentest/pt-432/2026-03-15-14_12.json, /var/log/kms-proxy/access.log (entry for req_id=abc123).
